name: cards
definition: 集换式卡牌游戏中的一张可被玩家使用或收藏的实体卡牌，具有名称、画家、颜色标识、法术力费用等属性。 Counterexample: 卡牌与卡牌系列（set）不同：卡牌是单张实体，系列是卡牌的发行集合；卡牌与卡牌异画（foreign_data）不同：异画是同一卡牌在不同语言下的文本记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table cards; provenance: direct source cards

name: foreign_data
definition: 记录同一张卡牌在非英文语言下的名称、文本、风味文本等本地化信息的信息记录。 Counterexample: 外文卡牌数据与卡牌不同：外文卡牌数据是卡牌的语言变体记录，不是独立的实体卡牌；外文卡牌数据与卡牌系列不同：它不描述发行集合。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table foreign_data; provenance: direct source foreign_data

name: legalities
definition: 记录某张卡牌在特定比赛赛制下是否被允许使用的规则状态信息。 Counterexample: 赛制合法性与卡牌不同：合法性是卡牌在赛制中的使用规则状态，不是卡牌本身；赛制合法性与禁限牌公告不同：它是静态规则记录，不是公告事件。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table legalities; provenance: direct source legalities

name: rulings
definition: 记录官方对某张卡牌规则交互或使用方式的正式解释与裁定的信息条目。 Counterexample: 卡牌裁定与赛制合法性不同：裁定解释规则如何适用，合法性说明是否允许使用；卡牌裁定与卡牌不同：裁定是规则解释文本，不是实体卡牌。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table rulings; provenance: direct source rulings

name: set_translations
definition: 记录卡牌系列名称在不同语言下的翻译文本的信息条目。 Counterexample: 系列翻译与卡牌系列不同：系列翻译是系列名称的语言变体，不是系列本身；系列翻译与外文卡牌数据不同：它翻译的是系列名，不是单张卡牌文本。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table set_translations; provenance: direct source set_translations

name: sets
definition: 集换式卡牌游戏中按发行计划发布的一组卡牌的集合，具有系列代码、名称、发行日期和总牌数等属性。 Counterexample: 卡牌系列与卡牌不同：系列是卡牌的发行集合，卡牌是系列中的单张实体；卡牌系列与系列翻译不同：系列翻译是系列名称的语言变体记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table sets; provenance: direct source sets

name: CardName
definition: The English name of a Magic card.

name: CardArtist
definition: The artist who illustrated the card.

name: ConvertedManaCost
definition: The converted mana cost of the card.

name: CardPower
definition: The power of a creature card.

name: CardSubtype
definition: The subtype(s) of the card.

name: CardType
definition: The type line of the card.

name: CardRarity
definition: The rarity of the card printing.

name: CardBorderColor
definition: The border color of the card.

name: CardHasContentWarning
definition: Flag indicating whether the card has a content warning.

name: CardIsStorySpotlight
definition: Flag indicating whether the card is a story spotlight card.

name: CardEDHRECRank
definition: The EDHRec rank of the card.

name: CardSetCode
definition: The code of the set the card belongs to.

name: CardSetName
definition: The name of the set the card belongs to.

name: CardSetTranslation
definition: The translated name of a set in a specific language.

name: CardSetBlock
definition: The block the set belongs to.

name: CardSetMCMName
definition: The name of the set on Magic Card Market.

name: CardSetMTGOCode
definition: The MTGO code of the set.

name: CardLanguage
definition: The language of the card text or set translation.

name: CardForeignName
definition: The name of the card in a foreign language.

name: CardForeignFlavorText
definition: The flavor text of the card in a foreign language.

name: CardForeignText
definition: The text of the card in a foreign language.

name: CardRulingText
definition: The text of a ruling for a card.

name: CardLegalityFormat
definition: The format for which legality is recorded.

name: CardLegalityStatus
definition: The legality status of the card in a format.

name: PercentageOfCardsWithContentWarning
definition: Percentage of cards that have (or do not have) a content warning. Formula: COUNT(CardHasContentWarning) / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardHasContentWarning = cards.hasContentWarning; CardName = cards.name
aliases: percentage of cards with content warning
percentage of cards without content warning

name: PercentageOfFrenchCards
definition: Percentage of cards that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French') / COUNT(CardName) * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language; CardName = cards.name

name: PercentageOfStorySpotlightCardsInFrench
definition: Percentage of story spotlight cards that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French' AND CardIsStorySpotlight = 1) / COUNT(CardIsStorySpotlight = 1) * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language; CardIsStorySpotlight = cards.isStorySpotlight
aliases: percentage of French story spotlight cards
percentage of story spotlight cards in french

name: PercentageOfCardsWithoutPowerInFrench
definition: Percentage of cards without power that are in French. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'French' AND CardPower IS NULL OR CardPower = '*') / COUNT(CardPower IS NULL OR CardPower = '*') * 100. Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language; CardPower = cards.power
aliases: percentage of cards without power in French
percentage of cards without power in french

name: CountOfBannedWhiteBorderCards
definition: Count of cards that are banned and have a white border. Formula: COUNT(CardLegalityStatus = 'Banned' AND CardBorderColor = 'white'). Inputs: CardLegalityStatus = legalities.status; CardBorderColor = cards.borderColor
aliases: number of banned white border cards
count of banned white border cards

name: CountOfCardsWithSubtypeNotAngel
definition: Count of cards whose subtype is not 'Angel'. Formula: COUNT(CardSubtype != 'Angel'). Inputs: CardSubtype = cards.subtypes
aliases: number of cards with subtype other than Angel
count of cards with subtype not angel

name: CountOfCardsByArtistInSet
definition: Count of cards by a specific artist in a specific set. Formula: COUNT(CardArtist = 'Adam Rex' AND CardSetTranslation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition'). Inputs: CardArtist = cards.artist; CardSetTranslation = set_translations.translation
aliases: number of cards designed by artist in set
count of cards by artist in set

name: CountOfTranslatedSetsInBlock
definition: Count of translated sets within a specific block. Formula: COUNT(CardSetBlock = 'Commander' AND CardLanguage = 'Portuguese (Brasil)'). Inputs: CardSetBlock = sets.block; CardLanguage = foreign_data.language
aliases: number of translated sets in block
count of translated sets in block

name: CountOfCardsWithEDHRECRank1
definition: Count of cards with EDHREC rank 1. Formula: COUNT(CardEDHRECRank = 1). Inputs: CardEDHRECRank = cards.edhrecRank
aliases: number of cards ranked 1st on EDHRec
count of cards with edhrec rank 1

name: CountOfMythicBannedCards
definition: Count of mythic rarity cards that are banned. Formula: COUNT(CardRarity = 'mythic' AND CardLegalityStatus = 'Banned'). Inputs: CardRarity = cards.rarity; CardLegalityStatus = legalities.status

name: CountOfCardsInSet
definition: Count of cards in a specific set. Formula: COUNT(CardSetName = 'Coldsnap'). Inputs: CardSetName = sets.name

name: CountOfCardsWithForeignLanguage
definition: Count of cards that have a foreign language version. Formula: COUNT(CardLanguage = 'Italian'). Inputs: CardLanguage = foreign_data.language
aliases: number of cards with foreign language
count of cards with foreign language

name: CountOfCardsWithRuling
definition: Count of cards that have a ruling. Formula: COUNT(CardRulingText). Inputs: CardRulingText = rulings.text

name: CountOfCardsWithLegality
definition: Count of cards that have a legality status. Formula: COUNT(CardLegalityStatus). Inputs: CardLegalityStatus = legalities.status

name: CountOfCardsWithMTGOCode
definition: Count of cards that have an MTGO code. Formula: COUNT(CardSetMTGOCode IS NOT NULL). Inputs: CardSetMTGOCode = sets.mtgoCode
aliases: number of cards with MTGO code
count of cards with mtgo code

name: CardLegality
definition: Answers questions about which formats a card is legal or banned in.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Answers questions about the language of card text or set translations.

name: CardRarity
definition: Answers questions about the rarity of card printings.

name: CardBorderColor
definition: Answers questions about the border color of cards.

name: CardSetBlock
definition: Answers questions about the block a set belongs to.
